sources.label: Official lululemon UK global size guide (Men: Tops chest; Bottoms US XXS-5XL waist/hip), cm, location United Kingdom

audit: Old source was a third-party retailer (Barry's). Official men's tops chart gives chest only (XS-XXL; XXS and 3XL-5XL have no measurements); waist and hip come from the men's bottoms letter-size chart on the same page for the same letters, as done for lululemon-w. Chest was nearly right (L 107 -> 106.5); waist was rounded (L 89 -> 88.9, XL 97 -> 96.5); hips added. UK/US/EU removed: lululemon's men's tops chart lists letters in every country row, not numeric UK/EU sizes.
